Subject: RE: Marquette Residential - New Submission

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Marquette Residential! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the construction type and year built for both locations?
- Are there any protection systems in place (sprinklers, alarms, security)?
- What are the primary occupancies at each location?
- Any planned renovations or improvements in the next 12 months?

Once I have these details, I'll be able to work up a competitive quote for you.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
